random.description: This image is a gross pathology photograph showing a cut section of a lung. The specimen reveals multiple dark, well-demarcated hemorrhagic areas within the lung parenchyma. These dark lesions are indicative of pulmonary infarction, characterized by ischemic necrosis and hemorrhage. The overall appearance is consistent with pulmonary infarction, likely resulting from a thromboembolic event.
